chapter: Magma Mountain: Kilnstep / The Breathing Kiln

authoritative_allocation.section: 10. Bounded route to exactly128 obtainable forms

forms.name: Coalcoil
forms.silhouette: A low snail with a broad smiling muzzle, two blunt eyestalks and a sideways crescent shell; pale foot clearly separate from charcoal shell.
forms.locomotion: Foot ripples in four readable waves; shell rocks after the head stops.
forms.field_role: Use store_heat only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Warm Thread
command.behavior: Draw a 40px ground thread after an 8-update warning; first crossing ends it. No through-wall segments.

acquisition.detail: Receive the rescued hatchling after manually moving an insulated jar to the marked cool shelf; no heat power is needed to earn it.

forms.name: Emberhelix
forms.silhouette: A raised snail on a narrow long foot; its open spiral shell sits upright with a large triangular window and expressive face below.
forms.locomotion: Stretch, brace, pull the shell forward; spiral tips lag by one pose.
forms.field_role: Use store_heat only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Coil Clamp
command.behavior: Two hooked arcs close on a 32px pocket; a target is hit once across both arcs. The player can walk through.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 31→32 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Hearthcrown
forms.silhouette: A long muscular snail with a flat fan-shaped shell held above its face on three connected shell ribs; large open spaces replace the earlier spiral.
forms.locomotion: Wide foot fans to anchor, then contracts into an unhurried glide.
forms.field_role: Use store_heat + ignite only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Crown Interval
command.behavior: Show three short spokes, then activate them in order; share a 32Q4 target budget across the whole cast. Gap remains visibly safe.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 32→33 choice after owning-family trial 2; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Shardibex
forms.silhouette: A small round-nosed mountain goat with short straight stone horns, wide cloven feet and a tilted rectangular shoulder patch.
forms.locomotion: Quick paired hoof plants, head dip, rear-foot catch-up.
forms.field_role: Use press_weight only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Heel Knock
command.behavior: A narrow 22px stomp cone interrupts eligible ordinary foes; no boss displacement or terrain mutation.

acquisition.detail: Raise the pedestrian brace with its public handwheel and guide the young ibex along the open terrace; no weight power is needed.

forms.name: Bracehorn
forms.silhouette: A low broad-shouldered goat with huge outward U-curved horns enclosing its face, short hindquarters and distinctly spread forehooves.
forms.locomotion: Three-beat brace and short forward shuffle; head stays level.
forms.field_role: Use press_weight + break_crack only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Brace Reply
command.behavior: Visible frontal bracing arc catches one eligible ordinary contact attack, then replies; expiry gives no damage and no invulnerability.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 34→35 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Spanram
forms.silhouette: A tall long-legged ram with two high buttress horns joining above its brow, a narrow waist and two strong negative-space arches.
forms.locomotion: High deliberate diagonal hoof steps; horns sway opposite hips.
forms.field_role: Use press_weight + break_crack only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Archfall
command.behavior: A visible overhead arch lands in a wide 44px frontal crescent after its warning. No temporary solid wall, crush or player push.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 35→36 choice after owning-family trial 2; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Tuftpika
forms.silhouette: A tiny pika with long swept-back grass whiskers, round ears, a square leafy tail tuft and two high-set dark eyes.
forms.locomotion: Compact four-paw gallop, pause, whisker flick.
forms.field_role: Use grow_roots only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Burr Skip
command.behavior: One bouncing seed follows two 18px ground hops; first ordinary hit gets a short visible slow. Walls end the path.

acquisition.detail: Follow paired nibble marks to a sheltered plot; put its visibly displaced seed tray back without clearing the living hedge.

forms.name: Rootmuffle
forms.silhouette: A low long-bodied pika with a broad root beard and two separated leafy shoulder mounds; its ears and living muzzle remain exposed.
forms.locomotion: Low belly-clear scamper; beard trails, then gathers beneath chin.
forms.field_role: Use grow_roots only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Root Hem
command.behavior: Two parallel 32px root lines leave a walkable central gap; crossing either gives one brief ordinary-root effect, never on a boss.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 37→38 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Sporevault
forms.silhouette: An upright long-hindleg pika with a closed pinecone tail carried above its head and a tiny chest between large open arm spaces.
forms.locomotion: Crouch, tall hop, two-foot settle; tail opens only during casting.
forms.field_role: Use grow_roots only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Cone Drop
command.behavior: Aimed visible 12px landing marker within48px; one falling cone hits after16 updates, with line of sight checked at aim and impact.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 37→39 choice after owning-family trial 2; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Chalklung
forms.silhouette: A living porous sponge with three soft lobed feet, one angled chimney and a friendly face on its lower flexible skirt.
forms.locomotion: Three-foot rocking walk; chimney compresses and rebounds as it breathes.
forms.field_role: Use fill_basin + reveal_current only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Mist Stop
command.behavior: A short square puff at28px arrests one eligible ordinary rush without pulling the player; one target hit per cast.

acquisition.detail: Read the three ripple marks and manually unclog the public catch bowl; a sponge walks out of the dry side niche.

forms.name: Bellcup
forms.silhouette: A tall sponge with an inverted bell mouth, a long curved neck, broad two-lobed base and a face looking out beneath the rim.
forms.locomotion: Leans forward on the base, straightens neck, then draws the base underneath.
forms.field_role: Use fill_basin + reveal_current only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Cup Shower
command.behavior: A stationary narrow three-drop column falls at a visible marker; all drops share24Q4 maximum per target.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 40→41 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Runnelribbon
forms.silhouette: A flat ribbon sponge with two raised breathing sails, four stub feet and a living face at one blunt leading corner.
forms.locomotion: Sideways inchworm fold, unfold and soft skirt sweep.
forms.field_role: Use fill_basin + reveal_current only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Ribbon Sweep
command.behavior: A45px lateral water band travels along one wall-checked segment; widens only after its first12px. Single target budget24Q4.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 40→42 choice after owning-family trial 2; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Orelet
forms.silhouette: A round mole with a pale snout, narrow metallic digging nails and one smooth ore nodule at the tip of its very short tail.
forms.locomotion: Alternating outward forepaw scoops with its feet visibly above the ground.
forms.field_role: Use draw_ore only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Pick Tap
command.behavior: Two short alternating nail jabs; second occurs only if first misses, so one enemy cannot take both.

acquisition.detail: Return two visibly labeled loose ore samples to their matching shelf shapes; the mole leaves its inspection basket.

forms.name: Augermole
forms.silhouette: A long wedge-bodied mole whose broad serrated forepaws frame a low face; its body tapers into a small straight tail.
forms.locomotion: Wide shoulder crawl with nails swept behind during recovery.
forms.field_role: Use draw_ore only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Spiral Notch
command.behavior: A narrow28px corkscrew strike; deals ordinary Metal damage with bounded stagger on an already vulnerable target. No armor bypass.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 43→44 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Pendulumole
forms.silhouette: An upright mole with long forearms, broad planted hindfeet and an elongated heavy tail curved into a counterweight loop.
forms.locomotion: Two hindfoot steps then tail counter-swing; face aims independently of arms.
forms.field_role: Use draw_ore only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Tail Pendulum
command.behavior: A short visible diagonal swing releases one18px lateral shard; swing and shard share24Q4, walls stop both.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 43→45 choice after owning-family trial 2; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Ashkite
forms.silhouette: A planthopper with a broad kite-shaped shell, very short antennae, tucked legs and a visible round face below a shallow hood.
forms.locomotion: Tiny spring hop, side slip and four-foot landing.
forms.field_role: Use turn_vane only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Cinder Tilt
command.behavior: One26px diagonal dart from the chosen facing side, with a readable aiming blink; stops at first wall or enemy.

acquisition.detail: Set a public wind hood away from the seedling bed using its handle, then approach the hopper shelter.

forms.name: Plumehopper
forms.silhouette: A tall long-legged hopper with a narrow upright plume, a pear-shaped abdomen and an open diamond between its rear legs.
forms.locomotion: High tucked-leg spring, upright hover beat and heel-first landing.
forms.field_role: Use turn_vane only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Plume Cut
command.behavior: A narrow rising slash then a forward falling slash; shared24Q4 target cap, no auto-tracking after startup.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 46→47 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Huskdrifter
forms.silhouette: A broad leaf-shaped hopper held horizontally beneath translucent folded shell sails, with a small face extending beyond their front edge.
forms.locomotion: Low skirt-like glide with visible occasional leg taps; not a permanent flight permission.
forms.field_role: Use turn_vane only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Ash Screen
command.behavior: A stationary small screen consumes one ordinary hostile projectile, expires after40 updates, then makes a16Q4 outward puff. Boss beams unaffected.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 46→48 choice after owning-family trial 2; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Screepeek
forms.silhouette: A stocky tapir with a short mobile trunk, small round ears, heavy hindquarters and three pale pebble pads along its shoulder.
forms.locomotion: Slow alternating four-foot stroll; trunk probes ahead on the idle beat.
forms.field_role: Use uncap_well only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Gravel Sift
command.behavior: A short fan of three ground chips, sharing20Q4 per target; maximum travel30px and wall stops per chip.

acquisition.detail: Uncover a clearly marked shallow spring lip with its A-operated brush; broad tracks lead to the waiting tapir.

forms.name: Stairtrunk
forms.silhouette: A long-trunked tapir with stepped flaring ears, high shoulders and low hindquarters, leaving a clear diagonal back silhouette.
forms.locomotion: Forefoot reach, trunk curl, broad rear step; ears fold on recovery.
forms.field_role: Use uncap_well only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Terrace Lift
command.behavior: A sequence of two rising28px wedges separated by a safe lateral gap; one hit per target across both, no forced boss movement.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 95→96 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Mossmarch
forms.silhouette: A short six-legged caterpillar-like animal with a square muzzle, four separated moss cushions and a bare expressive brow.
forms.locomotion: Six legs ripple in three pairs while cushions squash in sequence.
forms.field_role: Use reel_load only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Sprig March
command.behavior: One slow ground bud advances36px with a visible toe-like motion; it ends on first enemy or wall rather than lingering.

acquisition.detail: Inspect the moving moss along a frayed drying-line guide; solve the manual two-hook return and invite the crawler.

forms.name: Trellislong
forms.silhouette: A long high-arched six-legged crawler with an open lattice of connected moss ribs above its smooth living underside and wide face.
forms.locomotion: Three alternating leg pairs carry a traveling body arch, never a static stretched base sprite.
forms.field_role: Use reel_load only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Trellis Bend
command.behavior: Two connected ground segments form one chosen L-shaped path, capped48px total; one hit per target and no wall penetration.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 97→98 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

forms.name: Dripurchin
forms.silhouette: A low sea-urchin-like animal with a soft visible face, five blunt movable spines and three rounded tube feet.
forms.locomotion: Rotates its feet without rotating its face, then bobs with gathered droplets.
forms.field_role: Use tune_latch only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Bead Step
command.behavior: Three small outward beads leave large gaps; one enemy can receive only16Q4 across the fan. No homing.

acquisition.detail: Finish the optional Listening Stones discovery commission, then open the indicated quiet catch. The urchin is visible behind the grille before release.

forms.name: Dewmedusa
forms.silhouette: A tall soft-bodied urchin with its five spines opened into curved umbrella ribs and long joined tube-foot tassels; face hangs below the cap.
forms.locomotion: Gentle pulse-lift then trailing-foot settle; a grounded shadow makes its location legible.
forms.field_role: Use tune_latch only on the chapter's explicit compatible tagged fixtures; phase alone grants no action.

command.name: Dewfold
command.behavior: An expanding five-lobed ring shows safe gaps before moving; edge-only24Q4 once per target, never a full-screen burst.

acquisition.detail: Explicit 99→100 choice after owning-family trial 1; defer is unchanged.

trial_bindings.name: Three Cool Shelves
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Store heat from each of three numbered refractory jars, then park each at the matching safe shelf; never warm the seedling tray.

trial_bindings.name: One Hearth, Three Uses
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: As form32, reuse one charged brick to dry clay, temper a tool and warm seedlings in that order, cooling it at a marked sink between uses; prove all three different outputs.

trial_bindings.name: A Walkable Load
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Press three marked braces while each pedestrian side lane remains open; dragging a baffle into a walking lane invalidates only that attempt.

trial_bindings.name: The Unbroken Crossing
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: As form35, brace the high and low supports from opposite landings and move the central slab between them without blocking the marked return loop.

trial_bindings.name: Shelter the Roots
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Grow roots into two dry hedge ties while a third living opening stays clear; choose the low sheltered plot, not every green target.

trial_bindings.name: Scatter the Canopy
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Grow two elevated seed supports after manually opening the airflow hood; carry the marked seed tray by the open upper walkway.

trial_bindings.name: Keep the Last Drop
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Reveal the feeding current, fill the catch bowl and close two leaks before draining the practice outlet; targets have distinct shapes.

trial_bindings.name: Share the Runnel
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Reveal both branch arrows and fill alternating receiving bowls without feeding the already-full trough; no timer or random rain.

trial_bindings.name: True the Buried Seam
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Draw three sample pins out in the diagrammed direction while the protected pot is behind its baffle; each pin has an independent identity.

trial_bindings.name: Balance the Hanging Note
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Draw two counterweights to opposite marked rests until the hanging clapper clears both sides; the player can inspect its entire swing.

trial_bindings.name: Lift the Warm Air
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Turn three hood vanes to lift a visible ribbon through upper outlets without blowing on the seedling bed.

trial_bindings.name: Settle the Ash
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Turn the hood down into a settling basket, open its safe side bypass and return the hood to still; visible ash clears rather than becoming a damage cloud.

trial_bindings.name: Find the Cold Seam
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Uncap three signposted spring mouths in separate pockets after observing their distinct bubbles; one dry inspection socket must be left closed.

trial_bindings.name: The Cloth Stays Clear
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Reel the drying line through three marked hooks from different safe approaches while a wide worker passage remains unobstructed.

trial_bindings.name: The Quiet Chord
trial_bindings.environmental_proof: Tune three mechanically distinct catches after placing sound baffles on their pictogram rests; the source is geometry and vibration cues, not hearing acuity.

rooms.name: Kilnstep Commons
rooms.purpose: Rest, workshop courtyards, Q30 lesson, source kiosk and a visible mountain lift.

rooms.name: Pumice Terraces
rooms.purpose: Sheltered garden cells, branching uphill walk, Q31 brace lesson, five ecological encounters and rest.

rooms.name: Potters Walk
rooms.purpose: Working drying hall with an open courtyard window; baffles, sample shelves and return line.

rooms.name: Cloudwell Grotto
rooms.purpose: Cool seep-fed tube with skylight and dry ledges; spring and sound-baffle discoveries.

rooms.name: Intake Ledger
rooms.purpose: Move an insulated heat brick around a cold dividing wall, charge it with STORE_HEAT and seat it at the marked receiver.

rooms.name: Breathing Vault
rooms.purpose: Move a baffle and pressure shoe so the safe relief outlet remains clear; PRESS_WEIGHT seats the marked brace.

rooms.name: Return-Flue Gallery
rooms.purpose: Combine heat routing and the weight brace, then strike a visible release pin using any ordinary weapon; safe lower route remains open.

rooms.name: Caldera Bell
rooms.purpose: Redirect an oversealed civic kiln regulator; side lanes, heat-safe landing and a clearly warned coupling window.

Guide the young goat along the open pedestrian route

Seat brace in43 with PRESS_WEIGHT

Use three distinct safe shelf/baffle configurations

Open the bypass and fill the public basin without emptying the creature refuge

Open the return door from its safe outer approach

Use the public hook and free the clapper while its pedestrian lane stays open

Set the upper hood away from the marked seedbed
Carry the reusable seed tray to its clear landing and report

equipment.name: Ventstring Bow
equipment.tradeoff: Less reach than Headland Bow and less attack than Tidewood Bow; never mandatory for a puzzle.

equipment.name: Kilnweave Mail
equipment.tradeoff: Trades Hearthscale guard/health for lighter speed loss; distinct mixed option.

equipment.name: Pumice Boots
equipment.tradeoff: Half Trail Boots speed with a quarter-heart reserve; gives up Deck Boots roll reduction.

equipment.name: Bricklayer Belt
equipment.tradeoff: Trading movement and Woven health for limited defense/interruption.

equipment.name: Quietnote Ring
equipment.tradeoff: Less cooldown benefit than Resonance; modest movement alongside it, within clamps.

equipment.name: Terrace Sword
equipment.tradeoff: Between attack and spacing, but slower than Ropeguard; balance review may replace this bounded stat vector.
